## Episode Thesis

This is a Danish episode of Euroinvestor's Millionærklubben, with Lau Svendsen (Svendsen & Tudbo) and Henrik Drusebæk (Drusebæk Sabel). They discuss whether last week's sell-off in AI stocks is a normal correction or the start of something worse. Henrik is constructive: he calls it a minor correction, points to the large AI capex boom and growth signals from both the bond and stock markets, and prefers a broad global core portfolio overweight the US and tech. His preferred themes are cybersecurity, energy, commodities and defence, held through ETFs, and he is underweight Europe because of weak growth. Lau is more bearish: he calls US AI a bubble, expects a stock market crash at some point, and expects permanently higher inflation and a weaker dollar, though he does not expect a full collapse.
